stances.name: Ready
stances.description: Where every kata starts and ends.
stances.source: Kata finishes: 'ready stance', 'move to attention & bow out'.
stances.jayQuestion: Are Ready stance and Attention one stance or two? The sheets name both ('ready stance', then 'move to attention'). What does each look like, in one short line?

stances.name: Cat
stances.description: A short step back. It shows up in every kata so far.
stances.source: Basic Form 1-2, Keon, David and Goliath: 'short stepping to rear w/RF into cat stance'.
stances.jayQuestion: One short line on how to stand in cat stance, for kids.

stances.name: Front
stances.description: Step forward into it, ready to block and punch.
stances.source: Keon #3 and #9: 'step forward w/LF into front stance'.
stances.jayQuestion: One short line on how to stand in front stance, for kids.

stances.name: Fighting
stances.description: Jump into it to face a weapon, ready to kick.
stances.jayQuestion: One short line on how to stand in fighting stance, for kids. Is it used in any kata?

stances.name: Horse
